title: Ultimate Classic Wrestling Ring & Steel Cage Bundle with Figures & Mats
body_html:
Build the ultimate classic wrestling arena with this deluxe bundle from Figures Toy Company! This complete set brings together the essential pieces needed to create an action-packed wrestling figure display or play area.

The bundle includes the Ultimate Classic Wrestling Ring, Classic Steel Cage, Classic Referee action figure, Classic Announcer action figure and a starter assortment of Classic Blue Ring Mats. Additional mats are sold separately, making it easy to expand your ringside floor area.

The large wrestling ring measures approximately 21.5 x 21.5 inches and features a fabric ring skirt, padded foam ring mat, cloth turnbuckles and breakable ring steps. The detailed blue steel cage surrounds the ring and includes a working door for dramatic entrances, escapes and steel-cage showdowns.

Each Classic Blue Ring Mat measures approximately 4.25 x 6.25 x 0.25 inches and contains foam padding for a realistic cushioned appearance. Arrange the included mats around the ring to begin building a detailed ringside area.

The referee and announcer figures complete the presentation, providing the essential personalities needed to call the action and keep matches under control. Whether you are building a retro wrestling display, photographing custom matches or creating your own wrestling figure federation, this deluxe bundle gives you a strong foundation for an entire arena.

Bundle Includes:

  • Ultimate Classic Wrestling Ring
  • Classic Blue Steel Cage
  • Classic Referee action figure
  • Classic Announcer action figure
  • Starter assortment of Classic Blue Ring Mats
  • Each mat measures approximately 4.25 x 6.25 x 0.25 inches
  • Mats contain foam padding
  • Additional Classic Blue Ring Mats sold separately

Compatible with most modern and retro wrestling action figures. Figures, accessories and scenery not specifically listed above are not included.
